owner_note.text: The duplicate-bubble bug could not be reproduced on the real Dictate page: one spoken sentence made one say and one bubble. The partial_text fix was Refine-page only. The Dictate demo resumes its per-path session on reload, which can look like duplicates; that is the next thing to fix. Refine's capped test shows "Could not refine: Failed to fetch" on purpose once its 6-call limit is hit.
